summary: Develop practical compensation, benefits and pay analysis skills in five days. Explore the course outline and plan your training.
lede: Total rewards training connects compensation, benefits and other employee offerings to workforce and organizational needs. It is for compensation and benefits practitioners, reward managers and HR business partners who assess reward portfolios and make pay and benefits decisions. You will practise job evaluation, market pricing and pay equity analysis, then review incentive scorecards and model benefit costs to shape reward communication, governance and an integrated action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape compensation, benefits and employee reward decisions across an organization.
modules: Point-Factor Job Evaluation and Pay Equity
prerequisites: Working familiarity with compensation, benefits or human resources processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a basic understanding of your organization’s reward practices if available; the course uses illustrative exercises and does not require confidential employee data.
